messages:
Nina - People Ops: Quick note: Ethan joins Mon 5/12. Need to finalize I-9 method, BG check status, laptop delivery window, and temporary badge/parking for week 1.

Olivia - Recruiter: BG check completed with no issues this morning. ETA cleared.

Ethan - New Hire: Thanks! I can do I-9 in person. Shipping address is 88 Mission St, Apt 10B, SF, 94105.

Carlos - IT: Got it. Will image laptop with standard dev image and coordinate courier. Which courier window is preferred?

Nina - People Ops: We have courier slots Mon 5/12 09:00-11:00 and 15:00-17:00. Ethan, which works? Also HQ I-9 desk has 10:00 or 13:00 drop-in.

Ethan - New Hire: Morning works best. Please book courier 09:00-11:00 and 10:00 I-9 drop-in.

OnboardBot: Parking/badge request form link: https://redwood.internal/badge-request. Provide license plate or request a temporary daily pass.

Raj - Hiring Manager: I'll cover a 30m team intro at 2pm. Nina, can you add 1:1 with me at 3pm to go over onboarding tasks?

Nina - People Ops: Done. Courier confirmed for 5/12 09:00-11:00 (hold id shpt_77531). I-9 10:00 booked (I-9 Desk 1). Badge request submitted for daily temporary pass. Calendar invites sent for orientation 11:30-12:30, team intro 14:00, Raj 1:1 15:00.

Carlos - IT: Provisioning started, will send temp Slack + VPN instructions to Ethan email.

Ethan - New Hire: Thanks everyone, will bring passport for I-9 and bring printed direct deposit form if needed. Looking forward to Monday.

Nina - People Ops: Great — closing loop here. If anything changes reply in thread or DM me. :wave:
